title: Depictions of children dying were rife in 19th century literture, mirroring high...
content:
Depictions of children dying were rife in 19th century literture, mirroring high child mortality levels in real life. “People who want to dismantle a century of resolute public health measures, like vaccination, invite those horrors to return.”
